universal_patterns.pattern: any holder of a license[^.]*under this title

proposal.rationale:
The 10 undetermined sections fall into two groups that genuinely should NOT be treated as universal:

1) Title 24 Chapter 60 (telemedicine, §§ 6001-6005): This is a cross-cutting health-care-delivery chapter that lists specific boards in § 6002 (Podiatry ch. 5, Chiropractic ch. 7, Medical Licensure ch. 17, etc.). It applies only to the enumerated health-care boards, not to all occupations. § 6002 is an enumeration anchor — adding a trigger "professional licensing boards existing under this title" will let the walker capture the chapter cites that follow. The other sections (§§ 6001, 6003, 6004, 6005) are scope/practice rules tied to that enumeration and properly remain undetermined unless they themselves contain enumeration triggers; they should surface in triage.

2) Title 3 Chapter 102 (Interstate Compact for horse racing participants): This is a profession-specific compact for live horse racing participants, not an umbrella occupational scope. It should remain undetermined / be excluded as profession-specific — no universal pattern is appropriate.

I added one extra trigger ("professional licensing boards existing under this title") to catch the § 6002 enumeration, and broadened "licensed by" as a variant. Universal patterns are kept conservative — none of these sections contain "applies to every/any/all" language warranting universal scope.
